title: Research sprint goal: Lookup correctness: router experts, the tag parser and aliases answer what the kb holds

Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
